items.title: BSEC tightens dividend rules for listed firms
items.description: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission (BSEC) has decided to tighten compliance with dividend distribution rules by requiring listed companies to keep declared cash dividends in separate bank accounts to prevent their misuse.

items.title: Dutch-Bangla Bank organises strategic conclave in Cumilla
items.description: Dutch-Bangla Bank PLC recently held a strategic conclave for its Noakhali and Cumilla regions to formulate business strategies for branches and strengthen customer service.
